Dar suporte na divulgação os indicadores do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, atuando para aumentar e melhorar a produtividade e competitividade da organização.

Dar suporte na organização e controlar dos documentos e registros do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade da obra, mantendo a adequada preservação e recuperação desses documentos para permitir a montagem do Data Book do empreendimento.

Trabalhar de acordo com as normas e procedimentos internos da organização, de forma ética, cordial, profissional e transparente.

Participar das reuniões de obra, informando-se sobre os assuntos em pauta e definindo as ações que sejam precisas por parte da qualidade.

Zelar pela manutenção e preservação dos equipamentos e ferramentas, propriedade da empresa que estejam sob sua responsabilidade.


Requisitos dos candidatos

Necessário Ensino Técnico Completo em Edificações

Pacote Office

Desejável experiência no segmento da construção civil

Disponibilidade para trabalhar na Zona Norte/SP

title: NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering cutting-edge sequencing technologies and advancing life sciences research worldwide. We are dedicated to enabling affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding our impact across the Americas. If you’re passionate about genomics, NGS, and making a real difference in healthcare and research, join us on this exciting journey toward accessible innovation for all.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking an experienced NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM to lead our Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Bioinformatics, Quality, and Customer Experience teams across Latin America. This leadership role requires a solid scientific foundation in molecular biology, genetics, bioinformatics, or related life sciences, combined with strong operational and people management skills. You will ensure exceptional customer support, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across all post-sales service functions in the region.



RESPONSIBILITIES



  • Report directly to the Head of LATAM and collaborate closely with Global Technical Support, Training, Sales, and Service Operations leaders.
  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team including Field Application Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Field Bioinformaticians, and Customer Support professionals.
  • Oversee customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, ensuring that service requests, installations, and technical issues are managed effectively and within expected timelines.
  • Define individual training and development needs across the technical team and recommend staffing plans and hiring strategies.
  • Establish measurable goals and performance indicators (e.g., response time, first-time resolution, quality metrics).
  • Manage regional service operations including resource allocation, travel budgets, spare part inventory, and field reporting.
  • Ensure accurate communication and coordination between LATAM and global operations, cascading critical updates and initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical and operational lead for the Customer Experience Center (CEC) and Demo Lab, driving technical demonstrations and customer engagement.
  • Maintain alignment with global quality standards, ensuring compliance, traceability, and continuous improvement of support processes.
  • Able to support and coordinate teams across the LATAM time zones.


QUALIFICATIONS



  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Strong academic background or work experience in NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) is highly preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical support, field service, or applications management, ideally within the genomics or life sciences industry.
  • Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience guiding technical and scientific teams.
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities; capable of navigating global structures and driving results across functions.
  • Willingness to travel regionally and internationally, including occasional training or collaboration trips to China.


PAY RANGE AND COMPENSATION PACKAGE



MGI offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to employees and their dependents (including domestic partners), which includes:



  • Medical and dental coverage
  • Travel insurance
  • Meal vouchers
  • Gym allowance


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT



MGI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Asset Management Senior Consultant
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .

As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for a Senior Consultant / Manager – Asset Management to join our team in Brazil. This is a great opportunity for professionals with strong expertise in the asset management industry who are passionate about driving technological transformation in leading investment institutions.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead technology assessment projects within asset management entities, identifying gaps, opportunities, and defining transformation roadmaps.
  • Define and validate target architectures aligned with strategic business goals.
  • Conduct technical evaluations of complex architectures regarding functionality, scalability, and performance.
  • Oversee the selection, design, and implementation of core investment, portfolio management, risk, distribution, and reporting platforms.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, both local and international.
  • Interact with stakeholders from business, technology, and operations to ensure functional and technical alignment of proposed solutions.
  • Prepare functional and technical documentation, as well as executive presentations.
  • Stay up to date with the evolving technological and regulatory landscape in the Brazilian asset management industry.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in consulting or technology transformation roles within asset managers or banks with asset management operations.
  • Deep understanding of the Brazilian asset management industry: local regulations (CVM, ANBIMA), products, processes, and key market players.
  • Proven experience in technology assessment and system implementation projects in the investment environment.
  • Solid knowledge of core architectures, with experience integrating with Matera considered a plus.
  • Familiarity with integration technology stacks and cloud architectures.
  • Strong background in system architecture, integration models, and data modeling.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and client management skills.
  • Advanced English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience leading transformation programs in large financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Jira).
  • Experience with data analytics, investment reporting, or risk systems.
  • Certifications or specialization courses in financial markets, architecture, or cloud technologies.
  • Spanish proficiency valued.


What We Offer

  • Work in a dynamic, international environment with global mobility opportunities.
  • Continuous learning and official certifications.
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • A personalized development plan with mentorship and performance-based growth.

CLT Contract Benefits

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • And much more: a flexible work environment, internal events, travel, and wellness initiatives


Learn more about us: nfq.es | NFQ LinkedIn

Requisitos

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.

  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)

title: Product Owner (PO) Técnico/Analista de Negocios Sr
description:
Product Owner, PO Técnico ou Analista de Negócios Sênior

INGLES FLUENTE



  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, PO Técnico ou Analista de Negócios Sênior em projetos de modernização de dados, Business Intelligence ou APIs.
  • Forte aptidão técnica e fluência na comunicação com times de Engenharia de Dados e Backend.
  • Experiência prática com GraphQL e análise de payloads JSON complexos.
  • Habilidade para lidar com grandes volumes de dados e experiência em análise de datasets para validação.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em migração de dados de sistemas legacy para cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de crédito ou antifraude.
  • Experiência na definição de KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) para monitoramento de qualidade de dados (Data Quality).


Resumo do Cargo

Buscamos um Product Owner (PO) Técnico altamente motivado para liderar a frente de consumo de dados e relatórios dentro da workstream de modernização. O PO será a ponte essencial entre as necessidades de negócio e a complexidade técnica da integração de dados em arquiteturas cloud-native . O foco principal é garantir que os relatórios sejam construídos com precisão e eficiência, utilizando dados provenientes de sistemas legados migrados e do Data Fabric global.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão do Produto (Relatórios e Dados):
  • Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog de recursos (funcionalidades e histórias de usuário) necessários para o consumo de dados do Data Fabric e a construção dos relatórios finais.
  • Atuar como stakeholder primário para validação de entregas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Especialista em Integração e API:
  • Profundo conhecimento no consumo de dados via API , definindo padrões de requisição e resposta para payloads complexos.
  • Conhecimento prático em GraphQL é mandatório, sendo responsável por desenhar as queries mais eficientes para extração e composição dos dados no Orquestrador de Relatórios.
  • Trabalhar ativamente com o time de Engenharia para definir os schemas de dados e a governança de APIs.
  • Qualidade e Migração de Dados:
  • Liderar a fase de análise de dados migrados de sistemas legados para a nuvem , garantindo a integridade, a qualidade e a equivalência das informações.
  • Definir e coordenar a execução de Testes de Equivalência (Equivalence Testing) para garantir que os relatórios construídos na nova arquitetura (Data Fabric) correspondam exatamente aos resultados do sistema legado.
  • Colaboração Técnica e Operacional:
  • Colaborar diretamente com os Data Stewards e times de Engenharia de Dados para entender a origem, o tratamento e a disponibilização dos dados no Data Fabric.
  • Liderar o discovery e o refinamento de requisitos complexos, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis e performáticas.

title: Reporter
description:
Risk Event-Driven Distressed (REDD) Intelligence is looking for a reporter to cover corporates in Brazil out of our office in Sao Paulo.

The reporter will have a notable track record covering and breaking news and a solid understanding of the corporate credit space, working closely with our experienced team of financial reporters and analysts to cover performing/distressed corporates in Brazil.


Day-to-day activities include:


  • Breaking news on corporate finance and operations, turnarounds and restructurings, legal, regulatory and market developments affecting Brazilian issuers
  • Working closely with our market-leading team of reporters and analysts across the global emerging markets

Requirements:


  • A minimum three to five years’ experience with coverage of Brazil’s corporate space
  • A deep network of contacts in the business, asset management, banking, and legal communities
  • Knowledge of the corporate bond market and global/onshore credit
  • Facility with financial data and analysis related to coverage of the corporate space
  • Knowledge of the local dynamics affecting corporates under coverage
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a deadline-driven, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent English language writing skills


About REDD:


REDD produces real-time news and analysis on emerging market corporate and sovereign event-driven special situations, helping asset managers, bankers, and advisers assess opportunities in the high-yield and high-grade markets.

REDD is a strong proponent of gender and racial diversity, and an equal opportunity employer. We are a motivated team of free thinkers and expect our team members to be personable and dynamic, encouraging “out of the box” thinking and the ability to discuss and appreciate different points of view to avoid the blind spots presented by group think.

We can offer you an opportunity to pursue a challenging but rewarding career with ample progression within a diverse international organisation. We also offer a market-leading competitive salary package and flexible working arrangements.

Headquartered in London with bureaus across the global emerging markets, REDD Intelligence’s team is made up of professionals with investment banking, legal and financial reporting experience, leveraging regional relationships to report on catalysts related to a universe of over 3,500 companies and sovereigns under coverage.

title: Head of Charging
description:
About Vammo


Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.


About the role


As the Head of Charging Operations, you will be the executive leader responsible for defining and executing the strategy for the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Vammo's battery-swapping network which is the heart of our customer experience.


Reporting directly to the Founders, you will build and lead the organization that ensures not only the expansion of our charging network, but also its 24/7 operation. You will be the ultimate owner of this network efficiency and quality, managing the LiveOps, Field Operations, and Commercial Charging Teams, being responsible for preparing the area for 10x growth. This is a mission-critical leadership role that demands strategic vision, the ability to build high-performance teams, and a deep sense of ownership.


What You'll Do

  • Define the end-to-end Charging Ops strategy, including the detailed strategic plan and OKRs. Own the design of processes, systems, and team architecture required to scale the operation by 10x, improve efficiency, and increase customer satisfaction.
  • Own the area's full budget and P&L, managing and optimizing costs to meet company goals.
  • Define and monitor the area's core OKRs and KPIs.
  • Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams across LiveOps, Field Operations, and Infrastructure. Define the area's vision and culture, focusing on urgency, accountability, and data-driven problem-solving.
  • Serve as the ultimate owner of network uptime, reliability, and incident response, ensuring riders always have batteries available.
  • Own the end-to-end energy strategy to reduce cost per kWh, including managing procurement, exploring free market (Mercado Livre) opportunities, and implementing efficiency initiatives.
  • Lead the commercial and expansion strategy for the network, defining site selection criteria to secure prime locations and network balance, negotiating strategic partnerships, and overseeing installation/launch playbooks.
  • Build proactive Customer Experience (CX) processes to communicate downtime and protect our NPS.
  • Serve as the strategic voice of operations for the Product and Engineering teams, providing real-world feedback and guiding the hardware/software roadmap to improve operability.
  • Act as the final escalation point for critical incidents, conduct post-mortems, and implement structural changes to prevent recurrence.


What We're Looking For

  • 8-12 years professional experience
  • Excellent knowledge of Brazil and Latin American business practices
  • Track record of scoping, building, training and leading large multidisciplinary teams
  • Proven expertise in process design, optimization, and creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for large-scale operation
  • An analytical and strategic mindset, with strong data-driven decision-making skills and experience defining OKRs
  • Executive communication and influencing skills, capable of aligning tech, executive, and field teams.
  • Excels in planning and executing initiatives of varying durations and scales while effectively managing stakeholders.
  • Fosters collaborative and respectful work environments
  • Technical Curiosity, a drive to understand how systems, hardware, and data truly work and how to optimize them.
  • Experience in high-growth (hyper-growth) startups
  • Experience managing 24/7 systems.
  • Experience setting and leading priorities, objectives and strategic direction for entire orgs
  • Experience in mobility, energy, logistics, IoT, or telecommunications is a plus.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Strong alignment with the company’s values


Benefits

  • A leadership role at fast-growing startup changing the face of mobility in Latin America, backed by some of the best venture capitalists in the world
  • Working at a mission driven company - we are reducing carbon emissions across the world and putting more money into the pocket of disenfranchised populations
  • Being surrounded by a talented and ambitious team that wants to build something big 
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you dare, allowing you to develop quickly
  • Competitive salary package
  • Opportunity to own a piece of the company - equity package
  • Health Insurance

﻿

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Position Summary


The role will provide technical support for local laboratory work, with a primary focus on formulation development to support customer projects, the promotion of Vantage™ products, and customer events. Responsibilities include preparing reports and applying Vantage™ raw materials in formulations, with the goal of providing practical tools for the sales force and supporting strategic customers in the region.


The Research Scientist – Formulation & Application will be a science-driven project leader, responsible for planning, managing, supporting, and executing formulation and product development projects in LATAM, with a special emphasis on Brazil. This role will work closely with global R&D and Marketing teams, ideating, identifying, and developing new products for market launch, contributing to the growth of Vantage Personal Care in LATAM and globally.


Key responsibilities include developing formulations for major customers and evaluating their performance to demonstrate the benefits of our technologies, developing new personal care applications, and creating market-relevant concepts that promote Vantage™ technologies through marketing campaigns, customer events, trade shows, and industry activities. In addition, this role will design and perform (or coordinate) the necessary

performance tests to demonstrate and reinforce the value proposition of Vantage™ technologies.


Position Scope


The position will be located in Brasil.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


· Development of new formulations to highlight ingredients from Vantage portfolio and their added values in formulation (skin care, hair care, makeup, and toiletries applications) according to internal and external needs, such as Marketing campaigns, trade shows, customers events and needs etc.

· Support in tests for performance studies and sensorial tests for costumer projects.

· Contribute to new product development projects to improve VPC product portfolio, including discovering new products based on market trends and customers feedback, assessing technical feasibility, developing the new product, designing and conducting needed performance tests to improve the product design, and finalizing product specs, etc.

· Monitor stability testing of formulations: organoleptic and physicochemical analyses.

· Qualification of Vantage ingredients and issue the report with the results.

· Ensure the efficient operation of the laboratory (respect for SOPs, raw materials and packaging inventory management…).

· Use knowledge of routine laboratory safety procedures, SDS’s and interpretations of hazards/toxicity data to perform all laboratory work in accordance with the written safety manual and site safety policies.

· Be a steward for safety and continually drive awareness to ensure a safe work environment for all employees.

· Understand formulation procedures and technologies and incorporate this understanding into applications that add value to customer products.

· Maintain accurate records of all laboratory work and research in accordance with generally accepted laboratory principles.

· Manage the calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.


Note: The duties listed above are not all inclusive and may be subject to periodic updating or revision.


Education & Experience:


Education: Bachelor of Chemistry, Pharmacobiology, Cosmetics Technology, Pharmacy or related areas, linked to sciences (Chemistry).


Experience: between 5 to 8 years’ working experience in the cosmetics and chemical industry.




Knowledge, Skills, & Talents


· Spanish and English speaker.

· Being responsible, organized, proactive, problem-solving, easy to work in a team are characteristics inherent to the vacancy profile

· Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

· Excellent communication skills (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .


In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.


Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.


Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.


Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.

- 10年以上人力资源领域工作经验，其中至少5年以上作为区域HR负责人或高级HRBP，全面负责巴西的人力资源管理工作。

- 具备在高速增长、多变的创业环境中工作的成功经验，能够处理模糊性和复杂性。

- 出色的沟通、影响和协调能力，能够与不同文化背景的各级员工和业务领导者有效合作。

- 卓越的战略思维和解决问题的能力，能够将业务需求转化为具体的人力资源举措。


优先考虑：

title: Senior Technical Manager – Fixed Networks & Infrastructure
description:
About This Role

We're seeking an exceptional Senior Technical Manager who will architect and orchestrate mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure that powers millions of connections across Latin America. This is your opportunity to drive technological innovation, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of fixed network solutions.


What You'll Do


Strategic Leadership

  • Architect and deploy carrier-grade fixed network solutions across fiber optics, GPON/EPON, SDN/NFV, and bearer network ecosystems
  • Master end-to-end bearer networks: optical transport (DWDM/OTN), metro aggregation, IP/MPLS backbone, and microwave transmission
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams (15+ engineers) driving innovation and operational excellence
  • Drive technical strategy for large-scale network transformation projects aligned with business objectives


Operational Excellence

  • Execute logical deployment strategies including provisioning, service activation, and zero-touch deployment frameworks
  • Command Tier 3/4 technical support operations with root cause analysis and incident elimination protocols
  • Optimize warranty lifecycle and spares inventory ensuring <99% equipment availability
  • Delivery measurable improvements: 99.99%+ uptime, 40%+ MTTR reduction, enhanced operational efficiency


Technical Mastery

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management


What You Bring


Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.


Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations


Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies
  • Multi-vendor platforms: ZTE, Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, Cisco optical/routing equipment


Deployment & Operations

  • Complex cutover management and phased rollout strategies with zero service disruption
  • Multi-tier support framework design and escalation matrix implementation
  • Data-driven spares management and predictive maintenance programs
  • Vendor negotiation and RMA cycle management
  • Process automation and provisioning timeline reduction


Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to identify and develop high-potential talent, assessing how candidates think and solve problems under pressure
  • Building high-performing teams in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Strategic mindset balancing operational needs with long-term architectural vision
  • Cross-functional collaboration across deployment, support, procurement, and vendor management


Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)


Plus/Nice to Have

  • Wireless network experience (4G/5G RAN, microwave backhaul, small cells, DAS)
  • Wireless-wireline convergence architectures
  • Spectrum management and RF planning knowledge


Why Join Us


✅ Strategic Influence: Direct access to executive leadership shaping company direction

✅ Technical Autonomy: Select technologies, design architectures, and optimize operations

✅ Operational Impact: Transform deployment, support, and maintenance organization-wide

✅ Market Leadership: Partner with tier-1 carriers on

✅ Career Growth: Clear pathway to progress inside the company

title: Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil)
description:
We are a leading global fintech company providing cross-border payment solutions to enterprises worldwide, with operations across North America, Europe, the UK, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. As we strategically expand into the Brazilian market, we are seeking a seasoned Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil) to ensure full compliance of our local operations with Brazilian financial regulations, data protection laws (LGPD), AML/KYC requirements, and payment system frameworks. This role will serve as the primary liaison with local regulators (e.g., Banco Central do Brasil, Receita Federal, ANPD), lead compliance implementation, adapt technical systems to regulatory expectations, and support routine audits, while closely collaborating with global compliance and engineering teams to embed compliance into product development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical compliance liaison between the company and Brazilian regulators (including but not limited to Banco Central do Brasil, CVM, ANPD, Receita Federal);representing the engineering in regulatory engagements that involve system architecture, data flows, business contingency, audit logging, and other technical implementation aspects of compliance.
  • Participate in Brazil market-related requirements and project reviews, providing technical compliance oversight to assess requirements and ensure that products, technical architecture, and operational processes comply with Brazilian financial, payments, and data privacy regulations (such as LGPD, PIX-related rules, and BCB Resolutions), thereby enabling legally compliant business operations.;
  • Collaborate with global Compliance, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable technical specifications and system controls;
  • Support internal and external audits (e.g., SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) and prepare regulatory filings and compliance reports;
  • Continuously monitor regulatory developments in Brazil, assess impact on existing business and technical architecture, and propose mitigation strategies;
  • Drive the systematic and standardized documentation of technical artifacts to enhance compliance efficiency and auditability;
  • Provide compliance training and guidance to local business teams to foster a strong compliance culture.



Qualifications:


Required Qualifications

  • Language : Native-level Portuguese (written and spoken); fluent English for global collaboration;
  • Local Regulatory Knowledge : Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial regulatory landscape, including BCB payment system rules (e.g., PIX, SPB), AML/CFT regulations, and LGPD data protection requirements;
  • Technical Acumen : Familiarity with modern payment technology architectures (e.g., API-first, microservices, cloud infrastructure); ability to engage engineering teams on technical details such as data flows, encryption, and audit logging;
  • Hands-on Experience : Direct experience engaging with Brazilian regulators, submitting licensing applications, or managing on-site inspections;
  • Education : Bachelor’s degree or higher in Law, Finance, Information Technology, Risk Management, or related field.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Hold professional certifications such as CISSP, CAMS, CRCM, or similar;
  • Prior experience in fintech, payment institutions, or banking compliance roles;
  • Familiarity with international compliance standards (e.g., FATF Recommendations, GDPR, PCI-DSS) and their local implementation;
  • Experience working in multicultural teams and supporting cross-border compliance initiatives.


What We Offer


  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class compliance and engineering experts;
  • Continuous professional development and learning resources;
  • Inclusive, diverse, and results-driven culture.

title: Operations Manager
description:
As we prepare to launch our licensed operations in Brazil, we’re seeking a strategic yet hands-on Operations Manager to establish and lead all operational functions on the ground in São Paulo.

Leveraging Ant International’s core platforms for payments, compliance, reporting, and risk, your critical role is to operationalize these global capabilities in the Brazilian context: defining local workflows, adapting procedures to meet BACEN expectations across EMI, payments, and lending (SCD), managing internal partners, and ensuring flawless execution from day one.

With a lean local team and key functions still centralized, you’ll wear multiple hats: acting as builder, executor, regulator liaison as needed, and team leader—while contributing directly to how global practices evolve to serve Brazil’s unique market.


Key Responsibilities:


1. Local Operational Design & Regulatory Alignment

  • Lead the design and implementation of Brazil-specific operational frameworks across two license types: Payment Institution (EMI and PISP) and SCD (lending)—ensuring full alignment with current and upcoming BACEN requirements;
  • Translate regulatory expectations into actionable operational controls, feeding insights back to global teams to refine shared standards;
  • Define end-to-end procedures for payment processing (PIX, TED/DOC), loan disbursement (for SCD), reconciliation, and incident management—mapped to Ant’s global infrastructure;
  • Support Compliance and Business teams on operational matters during licensing reviews, audits, and ongoing supervision.


2. Cross-Border Execution & Global Integration

  • Partner closely with Ant International’s headquarters in China, working with product, risk, compliance, and engineering teams to ensure Brazil’s operational needs are reflected in global systems and policies;
  • Validate that data flows, reporting logic, and control mechanisms support accurate, timely submissions to Brazilian authorities (e.g., SISBACEN, periodic EMI/SCD reports, RFB, Sisbajud/CNJ, Simba, STA, local authorities in general, etc.);
  • Identify gaps between global processes and local regulatory or market realities—and drive pragmatic, compliant adaptations without compromising system integrity.


3. Hands-On Operational Leadership

  • In this foundational phase, personally execute critical tasks: validate regulatory reports, investigate transaction failures, reconcile settlement accounts, and test live workflows;
  • Manage relationships with local banks, payment scheme participants (e.g., PIX connectors), credit bureaus, and third-party vendors—ensuring seamless integration with Ant’s ecosystem;
  • Build and mentor the first wave of local operations talent as the team scales, instilling a culture of compliance, precision, and customer trust.


4. Risk, Controls & Scalability

  • Implement robust operational risk frameworks tailored to Brazil’s multi-product environment (payments + lending), leveraging Ant Group’s global standards while addressing local threats;
  • Maintain a dynamic risk register, lead incident reviews, and ensure all operational activities support BACEN’s fit-and-proper, capital adequacy, and consumer protection expectations;
  • Design scalable processes that can grow with volume—by optimizing configurations, automation, and human oversight within the existing global structure.


Who You Are:


Deep Expertise in Brazil’s Regulated Financial Landscape

  • 7+ years in operations, compliance, or risk within Brazilian banking, fintech, or financial services;
  • Essential: Direct experience with BACEN-regulated entities, particularly EMIs, Payment Institutions, or SCDs—including licensing processes, ongoing reporting, AML/KYC, reserve rules, and consumer credit regulations;
  • Basic knowledge of development/programming languages, APIs, and XML files is a plus;
  • Fluency in Portuguese (native or fluent) and English (professional proficiency/advanced). Chinese is a plus, not mandatory. Must be based in São Paulo.


Builder Mindset with Global Awareness

  • Proven ability to launch or scale operations in early-stage, regulated environments—you’ve operated where structure meets scrappiness;
  • Experience collaborating with international or offshore teams; you know how to influence without authority and translate local needs into global action, with a resilient and problem-solving-oriented approach;
  • Understand that excellence lies not in rebuilding systems, but in making world-class infrastructure work and adapt itself flawlessly in Brazil.


Operational Rigor & Accountability

  • Obsessive about accuracy, audit readiness, and regulatory detail—but also pragmatic and solution-oriented;
  • Equally comfortable presenting to regulators and debugging a reconciliation file at midnight;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, Economics, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CRC, CEA) are valued but not required.

title: Eletricista O&M - UFV Ciranda
description:
SOBRE A EMPRESA

A Recurrent Energy é uma das maiores e mais geograficamente diversificadas plataformas do mundo para desenvolvimento, propriedade e operação de projetos de energia solar em escala utilitária e armazenamento de energia. Com uma equipe líder do setor composta por especialistas internos em energia, somos uma subsidiária integral da Canadian Solar Inc. e atuamos como o braço global da Canadian Solar para desenvolvimento e serviços de energia.


Título do Cargo: Eletricista

Departamento: O&M (Operação e Manutenção)

Local: São José do Belmonte/PE (UFV Ciranda)


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Possuir alto grau de treinamento e conscientização em segurança, seguindo todas as regras de saúde, segurança e as políticas da empresa.
  • Solucionar problemas diários dos sistemas dos projetos para atingir as metas de disponibilidade.
  • Compreender as metas de produção horária e diária da usina solar. Caso haja risco de não alcançá-las, executar um plano corretivo ou escalar a situação.
  • Realizar manutenções rotineiras (PMs, testes de partida, etc.) nos equipamentos e determinar quando e que tipo de manutenção é necessária antes de escalar problemas ou questões.
  • Identificar potenciais problemas e sugerir mudanças ou ações corretivas.
  • Trabalhar com outros membros da equipe de O&M, subcontratados e outros grupos para melhorar continuamente o desempenho do sistema, impulsionar a qualidade do produto e reduzir custos de manutenção.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas em diversos sistemas da usina solar, como arranjos fotovoltaicos (PV), inversores, cubículos elétricos, transformadores, disjuntores, sistemas de comunicação e equipamentos de CFTV, entre outros.
  • Seguir cronogramas de manutenção e realizar manutenção preventiva dos equipamentos.
  • Ajudar no desenvolvimento de documentos padrão para operação, manutenção e treinamento dos equipamentos.
  • Apoiar o comissionamento e os testes dos projetos, fornecendo expertise técnica.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades comerciais sejam realizadas com os mais altos padrões éticos e em conformidade com o Código de Conduta Empresarial da Canadian Solar Solutions.
  • Seguir todas as regras e políticas ambientais, de saúde e segurança.
  • Executar outras tarefas e projetos conforme atribuído.


REQUISITOS

  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência profissional como eletricista.
  • Formação técnica de nível médio.
  • Experiência em diagnosticar e reparar diferentes tipos de máquinas e equipamentos elétricos.
  • Capacidade de ler e interpretar plantas, diagramas, esquemas, desenhos, manuais e especificações.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas computacionais e redes será um diferencial.
  • Forte ética profissional, atitude positiva em equipe e capacidade de atuar em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar fora do horário comercial normal (8h às 17h), atendendo emergências ou problemas nos equipamentos. Trabalho à noite e em fins de semana poderá ser necessário.
  • Certificação como operador ONS é um diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de até uma semana ocasionalmente.
  • CNH brasileira válida e sem restrições.

Graduação completa;

Experiência com produtos bancários, preferencialmente cartões de crédito, crédito rotativo ou produtos de empréstimo;

Conhecimento em ferramentas como Pacote Office, MIRO, Kanbanize, ou similares voltados à metodologia ágil;

Vivência em desenvolvimento de produtos, métodos ágeis, definição de requisitos e entendimento profundo do ciclo operacional de cartões;

Conhecimento sobre operações de crédito, produtos rotativos e funcionamento de transações, autorizações e backoffice de cartão.

Inglês avançado ou Fluente;

Forte capacidade de articulação com múltiplos stakeholders e gestão de prioridades concorrentes;

Tomada de decisão ágil, especialmente em momentos de pressão;

Curiosidade, olhar analítico e interesse genuíno pelo negócio, mercado financeiro e tendências do setor;

Experiência em engajar times, facilitar alinhamentos e promover colaboração;

Capacidade de atuar com prazos desafiadores e ritmo acelerado.

title: Analista de Cultura & Transformação Organizacional Senior
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia criada para transformar o mercado de serviços financeiros no Brasil e na América Latina. Estamos crescendo rápido, integrando novos negócios, acelerando inovação e construindo com intenção e consistência a cultura que sustentará nosso futuro.

Cultura, para nós, não é discurso: é sistema, prática e forma de operar.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

  • Atrair talentos conectando cultura + propósito + tecnologia.
  • Garantir coerência entre EVP, comunicação interna e jornada do colaborador.


Gestão da Mudança (Change Management)

  • Atuar em frentes de integração (como aquisição de novas empresas).
  • Apoiar iniciativas estruturais e culturais utilizando práticas modernas de gestão da mudança.
  • Participar da construção de estratégias de comunicação, onboarding, transição e sustentação.
  • Reduzir fricções, ampliar entendimento e fortalecer segurança psicológica durante movimentos de mudança.


Experiência do Colaborador

  • Construir experiências de onboarding que reflitam nossa identidade.
  • Mapear e evoluir a jornada do colaborador com foco em pertencimento, conexão e clareza.
  • Criar experiências internas que reforcem cultura e ampliem engajamento.
  • Atuar junto à liderança para sustentar a cultura no dia a dia.


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Construtor de Cultura):

  • Experiência sólida em cultura, transformação organizacional, EVP/EB e change management .
  • Vivência em empresas em crescimento, tech, integrações, reestruturações ou mudanças culturais relevantes .
  • Capacidade de criar narrativas claras, humanas e modernas .
  • Forte senso de dono, visão sistêmica e habilidade de navegar com diferentes perfis de liderança.
  • Equilíbrio entre criatividade + estrutura + execução .
  • Autonomia, maturidade emocional e excelente capacidade de comunicação.
  • Fluência em metodologias de mudança (PROSCI é diferencial).
  • Perfil que se identifica com ambientes dinâmicos, ambíguos e de construção contínua.


Por que essa vaga é única?

  • Você ajudará a desenhar a cultura de uma das empresas de tecnologia mais promissoras do setor financeiro.
  • Atuação direta com People & Culture estratégico .
  • Alto impacto na jornada de mais de mil Dimensers.
  • Espaço real para criar, influenciar, propor e transformar.
  • Trabalhar em uma empresa que vê cultura como parte do produto e da inovação , não como adereço.


Vamos construir a Dimensa do futuro.

Se você é alguém que não só fala de cultura, mas constrói, essa vaga é para você.

Assistência Médica

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.



Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: Especialista Suprimentos - Matéria Prima
description:
Sobre a vaga


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.


Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.


Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência


Sobre o papel

Realizar a gestão estratégica e operacional do suprimento de matéria-prima principal (produtos químicos primários, embalagem etc.), desde a identificação das necessidades de compra, desenvolvimento e gestão de fornecedores, negociação de contratos, acompanhamento da logística e da qualidade da matéria-prima, até a otimização de custos e a garantia do abastecimento contínuo e eficiente para a produção.



Atividades principais :

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de suprimentos de matéria-prima alinhadas com a produção e financeiros da empresa, considerando demanda, preços de mercado, disponibilidade e riscos;
  • Identificar, qualificar, desenvolver e gerenciar um portfólio de fornecedores de matéria-prima;
  • Liderar o processo de negociação de contratos de fornecimento de matéria-prima;

  • Colaborar estreitamente com as áreas de produção, planejamento, qualidade, financeiro e jurídico;

  • Buscar e avaliar continuamente novas fontes de suprimento de matéria-prima;
  • Criar e analisar indicadores que facilitem a administração das demandas de matéria-prima, tais como níveis de estoque, fluxo contínuo de abastecimento, Saving, Lead Time, acompanhamento da demanda, Prazo de Entregas, Devoluções;

  • Apoiar a gerência na administração dos custos, atuando na previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend);
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias, participar e apoiar projetos, inovação, modificações e modernização de sistemas e processos relacionados a área de Suprimentos;
  • Elaborar e propor de planos de contingência para as compras de matéria-prima.

title: Country Leader, Programs (Brazil)
description:
The Senior Advisor is the primary responsible executive for the success of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) program in-country. This role is accountable for delivering the full scope of the country program in alignment with AEPW Strategy 2030, ensuring that projects are designed and executed as part of a system-change agenda rather than isolated interventions. The Senior Advisor manages all in-country stakeholders—including government entities, DFIs, industry partners, and implementing organizations—and oversees AEPW staff, consultants, and contractors to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, compliantly, and with measurable impact.


The Senior Advisor is both a strategic representative of AEPW to external stakeholders and an operational manager ensuring contract compliance, impact reporting, and staff performance.


Key Responsibilities


1. Program Strategy & Alignment

  • Develop, maintain, and execute a comprehensive country strategy aligned with AEPW’s global Strategy 2030.
  • Ensure that 80–90% of projects drive system-level transformation (e.g., integrated waste infrastructure, EPR alignment, circular economy enablers) with the remaining 10–20% focused on pilots for learning, impact generation, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for replication and scaling across the country and region.
  • Anticipate regulatory, political, and market shifts that may affect the program; adapt strategy proactively


2. Stakeholder Engagement & Representation

  • Work very closely with AEPW Members, and facilitate all PAG, pre-PAG, and Member engagement relative to the Country Program Implementation.
  • Serve as AEPW’s senior representative in-country, maintaining strong relationships with: a) Local and national government ministries, regulators, and municipalities; b) DFIs and co-funding partners active in waste and circular economy infrastructure; c) Industry stakeholders including brands, recyclers, and waste operators; and d) Civil society groups, NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Represent AEPW in policy dialogues, conferences, and industry roundtables, ensuring the organization is seen as a co-creator of solutions.
  • Work with the Central PA team to ensure alignment of government relations.
  • Act as primary escalation point for all stakeholder issues arising within the program.


3. Project Development & Execution Oversight

  • Guide development of new projects to ensure alignment with program objectives and system-change principles.
  • Review and approve project proposals prior to submission to the Portfolio Management Committee / Governing Council.
  • Oversee in-country execution teams and implementing partners to ensure adherence to AEPW’s global standards.
  • Ensure strict compliance with AEPW’s E2E Program Implementation process, safeguard requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Conduct regular site visits, milestone reviews, and partner performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with Circular Solutions Centre to ensure technical due diligence and innovation pilots are rigorously assessed.


4. Contract Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all projects adhere to the terms of their contracts, including milestones, disbursement conditions, reporting obligations, and safeguard actions.
  • Work closely with Central Legal / Contracts to enforce compliance and resolve disputes.
  • Maintain a country-level risk register and escalate risks (financial, operational, reputational, HSE) to the Central Risk team.
  • Ensure world-class HSE standards are embedded in all project activities, in line with AEPW expectations and international best practices.


5. Financial Structuring & Oversight

  • Collaborate with Impact Finance to co-structure deals with DFIs, private investors, and corporate co-funders.
  • Monitor financial performance of all projects (grants, loans, blended finance) including repayment obligations.
  • Ensure transparent and timely financial reporting for donors, DFIs, and AEPW central finance.


6. Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Ensure all projects deliver on AEPW’s impact metrics: plastic waste collected, sorted, and valorized; access to waste management; jobs created; safety performance, etc..
  • Work with Global Support to provide accurate and timely reporting for impact metrics, Portfolio Management Committee / Governing council, donor, and member communications.
  • Facilitate external audits, evaluations, and lessons-learned reviews.


7. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and manage all AEPW employees and consultants in-country.
  • Ensure teams operate safely, efficiently, and productively with clear accountability.
  • Foster a culture of compliance, transparency, and impact delivery.
  • Build local capacity by coaching and developing staff and ensuring knowledge transfer across teams.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across functions (Execution, CSC, Support, Finance, Legal, PA and Strategy/Planning).


Requirements / Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, engineering, public policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum 20+ years’ experience in senior leadership roles within infrastructure, development, or circular economy sectors.
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with government, DFIs, corporates, and NGOs.
  • Strong contract management, compliance, and risk oversight skills.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen in structuring and monitoring large-scale projects.
  • Experience working in international development, public-private partnerships, or donor-funded projects highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and diplomatic skills.
  • High integrity, resilience under pressure, and ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on operational management.

title: Integration Engineer
description:

  • Collaborative and inclusive team player with superb written and verbal communication skills
